title: Cheat Sheet - Win32
markdown:
## The skeleton

```cpp-norun
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>

LRESULT CALLBACK WndProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (msg)
    {
    case WM_CREATE:  /* create controls */ return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:    /* layout(LOWORD(lParam), HIWORD(lParam)) */ return 0;
    case WM_PAINT:   { PAINTSTRUCT ps; HDC dc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &ps); /* draw */ EndPaint(hwnd, &ps); return 0; }
    case WM_CLOSE:   /* ask to save; then */ DestroyWindow(hwnd); return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY: PostQuitMessage(0); return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE inst, HINSTANCE, PWSTR, int show)
{
    WNDCLASSEXW wc{ sizeof(wc) };
    wc.lpfnWndProc = WndProc; wc.hInstance = inst; wc.lpszClassName = L"Main";
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW); wc.hbrBackground = reinterpret_cast<HBRUSH>(COLOR_WINDOW + 1);
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
    HWND hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, L"Main", L"Title", WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 800, 500, nullptr, nullptr, inst, nullptr);
    ShowWindow(hwnd, show);
    MSG m;
    while (GetMessageW(&m, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) { TranslateMessage(&m); DispatchMessageW(&m); }
    return static_cast<int>(m.wParam);
}
```

## Messages

| Message | wParam / lParam |
|---|---|
| `WM_SIZE` | type / `LOWORD` width, `HIWORD` height |
| `WM_LBUTTONDOWN`, `WM_MOUSEMOVE` | `MK_` flags / `GET_X_LPARAM`, `GET_Y_LPARAM` (signed) |
| `WM_MOUSEWHEEL` | `GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM` (120 per notch) / screen position |
| `WM_KEYDOWN`, `WM_KEYUP` | virtual key / repeat count, scan code, bit 30 = was down |
| `WM_CHAR` | UTF-16 unit / as for keys |
| `WM_COMMAND` | `LOWORD` id, `HIWORD` code (0 menu, 1 accelerator, else notification) / control |
| `WM_NOTIFY` | id / `NMHDR*` |
| `WM_TIMER` | timer id / callback |
| `WM_DPICHANGED` | `HIWORD` new DPI / suggested `RECT*` |
| `WM_APP + n` | your own messages |

`PostMessageW` queues and returns; `SendMessageW` calls and waits.

## Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 2 / 3 | File / path not found |
| 5 | Access denied |
| 32 | Sharing violation (file in use) |
| 87 | Invalid parameter |
| 183 | Already exists |
| 1223 | Cancelled by the user |

`FAILED(hr)` for HRESULTs; `HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(code)`; `FormatMessageW` for text.

## Strings

```cpp-norun
MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, utf8, len, nullptr, 0);   // size first, then convert
WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS, utf16, len, nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
```

## Controls

| Task | Call |
|---|---|
| Find a control | `GetDlgItem(parent, id)` |
| Text | `SetDlgItemTextW`, `GetDlgItemTextW`, `GetWindowTextLengthW` |
| Check box | `CheckDlgButton`, `IsDlgButtonChecked` |
| List box | `LB_ADDSTRING`, `LB_GETCURSEL`, `LB_FINDSTRING` |
| Font | `SendMessageW(ctrl, WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)font, TRUE)` |
| Tab navigation | `IsDialogMessageW` in the loop |
| Move many | `BeginDeferWindowPos` / `DeferWindowPos` / `EndDeferWindowPos` |

## Drawing

| GDI | Direct2D |
|---|---|
| `BeginPaint` / `EndPaint` | `BeginDraw` / `EndDraw` (check `D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET`) |
| `CreatePen`, `CreateSolidBrush` + `SelectObject` + `DeleteObject` | `CreateSolidColorBrush` (a ComPtr) |
| `FillRect`, `Rectangle`, `Ellipse`, `LineTo` | `FillRectangle`, `DrawRectangle`, `FillEllipse`, `DrawLine` |
| `DrawTextW` | `DrawTextLayout` with a DirectWrite layout |
| `InvalidateRect(hwnd, &r, FALSE)` | the same |
| `RGB(r, g, b)` = `0x00BBGGRR` | `D2D1::ColorF(r, g, b, a)` with floats 0..1 |

## DPI

```cpp-norun
const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd);
int px = MulDiv(designPx, dpi, 96);
int fontHeight = -MulDiv(points, dpi, 72);
```

## Files and system

| Task | Call |
|---|---|
| Open a file | `CreateFileW(path, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr)` |
| List a folder | `FindFirstFileExW` / `FindNextFileW` / `FindClose` (skip `.`, `..`, reparse points) |
| Replace safely | write a temp file, then `ReplaceFileW` or `MoveFileExW(..., MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING)` |
| Settings folder | `SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_RoamingAppData, ...)` |
| Registry | `RegGetValueW`, `RegCreateKeyExW`, `RegSetValueExW` (size in bytes incl. null) |
| Run a program | `CreateProcessW(nullptr, mutableCmdLine, ...)`, close both handles |
| Open a document | `ShellExecuteExW` with verb `open` |
| Worker to UI | `PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_APP + n, 0, (LPARAM)new Data)` |
| Clipboard | `OpenClipboard`, `EmptyClipboard`, `SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, hglobal)`, `CloseClipboard` |
| Dropped files | `DragAcceptFiles`, `WM_DROPFILES`, `DragQueryFileW`, `DragFinish` |

## Deeper into the system (milestone 7)

| Task | Call |
|---|---|
| Reserve, then commit | `VirtualAlloc(nullptr, size, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_NOACCESS)`, then `VirtualAlloc(p, n, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)` |
| Page size and granularity | `GetSystemInfo`: `dwPageSize` (4 KB), `dwAllocationGranularity` (64 KB) |
| Protection | `VirtualProtect(p, n, PAGE_READONLY, &old)` |
| Inspect memory | `VirtualQuery(p, &mbi, sizeof mbi)` |
| Free | `VirtualFree(p, n, MEM_DECOMMIT)`; `VirtualFree(base, 0, MEM_RELEASE)` |
| Console text | `WriteConsoleW`, or `SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8)` |
| Colours | turn on `ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING` with `SetConsoleMode`, then write `ESC[32m` ... `ESC[0m` |
| Keys | `ReadConsoleInputW`, `KEY_EVENT` records |
| Ctrl+C | `SetConsoleCtrlHandler(handler, TRUE)` |
| Overlapped read | `FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED`; `OVERLAPPED` with `Offset` and `OffsetHigh`; `ERROR_IO_PENDING` means started |
| Completion port | `CreateIoCompletionPort`, `GetQueuedCompletionStatus`, `PostQueuedCompletionStatus` |
| Cancel | `CancelIoEx(h, &ov)`; wait for `ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED` |
| Service | `StartServiceCtrlDispatcherW`, `RegisterServiceCtrlHandlerExW`, `SetServiceStatus` |
| Install a service | `sc create Name binPath= "C:\path\app.exe" start= auto` |
| Your token | `OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &t)`, `GetTokenInformation` |
| Elevated? | `TokenElevation`; manifest `requestedExecutionLevel` |
| SID as text | `ConvertSidToStringSidW`, then `LocalFree` |
| Enable a privilege | `LookupPrivilegeValueW`, `AdjustTokenPrivileges`, check `ERROR_NOT_ALL_ASSIGNED` |
| COM | `CoInitializeEx`, `CoCreateInstance(..., IID_PPV_ARGS(&p))`, `ComPtr`, `CoUninitialize` |
| COM memory | `CoTaskMemFree`; `SysFreeString` for a `BSTR` |
